placers.name: Tori Matthews
placers.note: Class of 2031: a seventh grader when she placed 4 at 235 in the 2026 MHSAA championship. Mississippi let them wrestle for a member school and the medal is real, but the platform mints a profile only for a current class year (2027-2030), so a class of 2031 has nowhere to sit yet and a guessed one would be worse. The placement is stored and linked; the profile follows when 2031 enters the window. Class year from the grade the tournament published (29 Oct 2026).

preFreshmanVerified.note: Alejandro Edoria, Ocean Springs High School, class of 2028. Before his freshman year he placed 3 in 2024. Mississippi's brackets admitted them: the package's grade evidence carries 59 eighth-grade and 20 seventh-grade entries, and each class year here is derived from the grade the tournament itself published - the same field that flags the result as pre-freshman. The MHSAA sanctioned wrestling only recently and its fields are small, which is why a third of the state's profiles carry one of these. The package cites no MHSAA by-law, so what is verified is the event's own record of who wrestled, not the rule behind it. Different from Maryland (COMAR 13A.06.03.02, grades 9-12 only) and Virginia (VHSL 28-2-1, eighth graders on junior varsity only), where the same shape proved a class year wrong (29 Oct 2026).
